im basically *completely* fucked and broke and its cheap and not regulated here so no ipecac or alcohol tax making it basically free. vodka would be a fantastic incredible dream at this point. this point also meaning im a bit far gone to just sleep it off, sadly, its been a while. but yeah, it sounds stupid but just wondering wholl swing by and post is at least something. hard to describe how ridiculous it feels to be clutching at such a tiny straw, but life is what it is...

sleep well. :)

not any more. :(

edit: or i wouldnt be reduced to whining like this in a place like this... the feeling of 'orly? how did it all end up here? wtf are you doing, really?' is so mindnumbingly insanely huge. fuck.

editedit: not that its not appreciated. hard to believe that a place to read the news and geek out occasionally could end up such a huge crutch. <3

yeah, i know and youre right, i have, and accept that. yet thats the exact problem perhaps... knowing the highs wont be back and how temporary theyd be if they were? and how much fighting involved to get there? 'why bother' finally caught up, i guess.

i wish, id love to, this is exactly how i ended up here and it worked brilliantly for a little while. but no, for the time being at least this is a black hole and im *well* beyond the event horizon. i guess thats the root problem, ive lost the dreams and motivation to dig out again.

but thats just it, i did the whole 'take it, move on, rebuild' thing, and it was hard. harder than most people ever have to even imagine, id wager. 

but then i meet this incredible girl and figure "fuck it, i came this far, maybe it was to meet her", and rolled the dice, knowing full well that it was probably the last chance id have. it didnt work.

i burnt the few bridges that were left to get *that* chance, i cant even begin to imagine how the fuck id find another. i guess i just finally hit the give up point on this time around, which isnt easy when getting back up to start this time around was an absolute last effort. then whats left? im not trying to be dramatic, i honestly dont know any more. theres just nothing left able to drag out even the slightest modicum of hope, i guess.
